notes: New in 1.0.7: per-clone version display + manual Check update in the long-press menu (her order). Long-press (or tap the 3 dots) on any clone and the menu now shows two lines at the top: 'Clone version: x' and 'Original version: y', so you can see at a glance whether the clone has followed the real Muse app - plus a 'Check update' item that checks and updates just that clone on demand and always toasts the result ('Naka-update na ang clone na ito (v…)' or 'Na-update ang clone: v… → v…'). The manual check bypasses the throttle and never runs at the same time as the automatic check. Includes 1.0.6 (clone auto-update that REALLY works: engine-ready trigger, throttle stamped only after a real check, PACKAGE_REPLACED receiver so clones follow a Play Store update immediately), 1.0.5 (Meta Account page / ERR_CACHE_MISS fix) and 1.0.4 (toast when clones update; every check logged). Installs in place - clones and sign-ins are preserved.
